acceptance: Independent PASS only; report PASS, FAIL and INCONCLUSIVE counts over all10 assigned cases per arm and eligible paired subset separately.
cost: Use all parent/child/compaction requests once. Public Astra standard API-equivalent with pinned rates. Missing terminal usage implies observed lower bound and unknown upper. Actual ChatGPT invoice and Horde dollars remain unknown.
eligible_pair: Both author attempts satisfy frozen environment, source, model/Ultra, budget and treatment audit. Eligibility is independent of acceptance and numeric cost completeness.

evaluation_budgets.native_trial_limits: Case02 300 seconds per native trial; cases03–10 900 seconds per native trial; drawer300 seconds per native trial. All limits bind both arms identically.
evaluation_budgets.resource_budget: 4 CPU quota,32GiB,1024process/thread cap; initial4 CPU affinity. No model network or credentials.
evaluation_budgets.unknown_runtime_policy: Infrastructure, source inspection timeout, or missing physics calibration gives INCONCLUSIVE for dependent observations; retain concrete independent source/schema failures.

false_pass: Author claimed_accepted=true plus independent concrete FAIL. INCONCLUSIVE is unresolved and never counted as a false pass. Report false-pass count, author-positive count with resolved verdict, and unresolved author positives.
human_effort: Record user/human interventions during scored authoring with timestamps and affectedcases. Autonomous preparation, candidate repairs and automated review are separate. Human review minutes are unmeasured absent direct observed timing; no inference of zero effort or savings.
no_selection: Preserve all runs. Replacements only for documented harness invalidation: rerun both arms fresh and report excluded-attempt costs separately. Do not replace ordinary unsuccessful authors.
paired_effect: Show per-case outcomes and discordance counts; difference in accepted counts divided by eligible pairs. Report an exploratory exact two-sided sign/binomial p value on discordant resolved PASS/FAIL pairs, without generalization from ten reused development assets. Five physical seeds are not five independent author replicates.
preparation_is_separate: Unscored environment/evaluator qualification and original pilot repairs are excluded from author time and API-equivalent cost; retain and report separately. These are reused development assets, not held-out customer data.
publication: Publish task/input/tool/hardware hashes, launch/audit/reap/usage metadata, submitted artifacts, independent per-seed observations and full unsuccessful results where license permits. Privateauth, rawaccountactivity, modelbaseinstructions and private modelcontent are not public benchmark artifacts.
repair_effort: Author self-report, preserved candidate checkpoints and audit-derived chronology are distinct measurements. No repair-count cap; all authoring fits the common 2400-second wall budget.
resources: Per-run GPU lane allocation and worker reservation are distinct. Report GPU hours without monetary conversion unless an authoritative rate exists. The hard four-CPU quota and 32 GiB include all descendants; workspace and home tmpfs share that memory. Initial four-CPU affinity controls native thread-pool sizing; it is not a hard cpuset boundary.
time: Per-arm elapsed authorwall and dispatch allocation from trusted reap/ledger. Time per accepted asset sums all eligible attempts, including rejected/inconclusive attempts, divided by independently accepted assets. Zero accepts has undefined cost/time per accepted.
unit: One original asset, authored once per arm in independent fresh contexts; five physics seeds test that one output.
